scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/web && npm install
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run install:backend
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/web/.next apps/web/node_modules node_modules backend/venv backend/__pycache__ backend/app/__pycache__
